(1) spatial ability can be improved through tangible interaction, (2) spatial ability can also be improved through virtual interaction, and (3) spatial ability can even be improved when tangible and virtual interactions are combined.

1) tangible interaction can help people solve spatial problems better; 2) virtual interaction can help people learn and practice spatial ability; 3) the embodiment of spatial problems in virtual interaction can lead to better spatial ability learning and transfer.

1) tangible and virtual interactions can be integrated to support spatial cognition; 2) tangible and virtual manipulatives are more effective than surface based manipulatives; and 3) virtual manipulatives can be as effective as tangible ones in improving spatial ability.
